svg.title: DAMA segments to FAIRMM dimensions: Direct and Indirect proposed alignment
svg.desc: 14 DAMA areas and additional topics connect to seven FAIRMM dimensions through 45 Direct and 9 Indirect equal-width ribbons. Blue is Direct; amber with a dashed edge is Indirect. These are conditional dimension relationships, not maturity scores.

g.text: Proposed dimension alignment · FAIRMM v1.2.5 · 16 November 2026

g.text: Direct / Indirect describes dimension support, separately from the source FAIR-principle classification.
Conditional proposals; width is not strength or maturity. Topics 12–14 are additional to the 11 core knowledge areas.
